skill.summary: Coach a licensed mental-health clinician (LCSW, LMFT, LPC/LPCC, PsyD, PhD, LMHC, LICSW, LCPC) through launching, scaling, or pivoting a private psychotherapy...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — specialized coaching for US mental health clinicians launching or scaling private psychotherapy practices in 2026.

- Supports decision-making on practice models: solo cash-pay, insurance-paneled, platforms (Headway/Alma/etc.), joining/starting a group, or subscription models
- Guides on economics: insurance reimbursement, cash-pay pricing, credentialing timelines, cash flow, realistic income, practice-unit economics, and burnout risks
- Covers platform comparisons (Headway, Alma, Grow Therapy, SonderMind), EHR/practice management tools, legal/business setup, and marketing strategies
- Defines clear intake process: license, state, specialty, practice setting, geography, financial/runway assessment, and goals
- Outlines failure modes and sustainable growth paths specific to the post-2020 market landscape
